1 أَحِنَ (S, Msb, K) عَلَيْهِ, (S, TA,) aor.
اَحَنَ , (Msb, K,) inf. n. أَحَنٌ, (Msb,) or أَحْنٌ, and إِحْنَةٌ, (TA,) or this last is a simple subst.; (Msb;) and أَحَنَ عَلَيْهِ, aor.
اَحَنَ , inf. n. أَحْنٌ; (Kr, TA;) He retained enmity against him in his bosom, watching for an opportunity to indulge it, or exercise it; or hid enmity against him in his bosom; or bore rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite, against him: (S, Msb, K: *) and he was affected with anger (K, TA) against him, such as came upon him suddenly from the retention or hiding of enmity in the bosom, or from rancour, malevolence, malice, or spite. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
